subcategory_text: Identify AI-specific vulnerabilities continuously via automated red-teaming, adversarial-input scanning, model-output monitoring, third-party advisories, and bug-bounty intake.
implementation_examples: Run scheduled red-team prompt sweeps against deployed models
Subscribe to model-vulnerability advisories for the model's provider
Monitor production outputs for jailbreak or extraction indicators
assessment_objectives: Determine whether AI vulnerabilities are identified continuously.
Determine whether production behaviour is monitored for attack indicators.
